newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork shares reverse gains after results.
newsitem.headline: Stork shares reverse gains after results.

text.p: Shares of industrial systems and services group Stork NV shed earlier gains and sank to a loss following publication of its first half results.
Stork reported that first-half net profit rose 22 percent to 40.4 million guilders from 33.2 million -- more or less in line with analysts' expectations.
But the results were helped along by net interest income of 5.1 million guilders, compared with net interest charges of 3.9 million in the first half of 1995.
At 1235 GMT Stork shares were off 2.20 guilders at 50.70, having shown a gain of over one guilder before the results.
